subject: Error when reading csv from shared folder

messages.author: 354284d471ce8a6a
messages.subject: Error when reading csv from shared folder
parts:
Hi

At work we have an Ubuntu server installation on a virtual machine with Shiny Server installed and working.  Our CSV files are created on the Windows server and placed in a shared folder.  The folder is linked to in Ubuntu.  One problem I have is that periodically the shiny app fails to load when navigating to the page.  The error logs for the app reads:

Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
Warning in file(file, "rt") :
    cannot open file '../csvShare/Referrals.csv" : Host is down
Warning: Error in file: cannot open the connection
Stack trace (innermost first):
     45: file
     44: read.table
     43: read.csv
     42: server [/srv/shiny-server/referrals/server.R#18]
       1: runApp


My fstab file points correctly to the shared folder and reads my credentials from a file I set up.

//abcsql213/ssisimports/SharedCSV /srv/shiny-server/csvShare cifs credentials = /home/andrew/.smbcredentials,iocharset=utf8, sec=ntlm 0 0


For some strange reason it seems to work fine for a few hours then simply fails to load.  I don't know if the problem is with Shiny or the Windows Share folder.

Any help appreciated

Andrew

messages.author: f562cc721b7e9a13
messages.subject: Re: Error when reading csv from shared folder
parts:
A good way to eliminate these errors is to place an rsync in cron on the Ubuntu server every 5 minutes or so that places it directly in a local file system.

Another alternative is a ssh rsync from Windows to Ubuntu each time the file is updated. This would also make it local to Ubuntu.
